morphology.pattern_note: 数据包误将派生词整体标为词根；依据 DBP 的 kelahi 词条更正。词根 kelahi 保持原形，词尾 i 与后缀 -an 相接，不发生鼻音同化。

senses.zh_definition: 争吵、争执或打斗这一行为或事件；可以仅涉及言语，也可以涉及肢体冲突。
senses.en_definition: An incident or act of quarrelling or fighting, involving verbal conflict or physical violence.
senses.nuances: 指已经形成对立的争吵或争斗，强于一般的意见不同。词本身不保证发生肢体暴力，是否动手须结合上下文判断。日常口语常改用 gaduh 或 bergaduh。[DBP：kelahi 及其派生词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=kelahi)

dual_scenarios.ms: Pihak polis sedang menyiasat punca perkelahian antara dua kumpulan di kawasan tempat letak kereta itu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 警方正在调查两伙人在该停车场发生争斗的原因。
dual_scenarios.en: Police are investigating the cause of a fight between two groups in the car park.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友谈论附近发生的冲突
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Perkelahian kat kedai tadi dah reda ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah perkelahian di kedai tadi sudah reda?
dual_scenarios.zh: 刚才店里那场争斗平息了吗？
dual_scenarios.en: Has that fight at the shop died down?
spoken_features: 句末 ke 表示口语疑问
perkelahian 可用于叙述事件；随意交谈中 gaduh 更常见

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Perkelahian kat kedai tadi dah reda ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah perkelahian di kedai tadi sudah reda?
messages.zh: 刚才店里那场争斗平息了吗？
messages.en: Has that fight at the shop died down?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah. Orang kat situ dah leraikan mereka. Sekarang semua dah tenang.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, perkelahian itu sudah reda. Orang di situ sudah meleraikan mereka. Sekarang semuanya sudah tenang.
messages.zh: 平息了。现场的人已经把他们劝开了，现在大家都冷静下来了。
messages.en: Yes. People there broke it up, and everyone has calmed down.

etymology.historical_story: Perkelahian belongs to the Malay kelahi family. The circumfix per-...-an turns the underlying idea of quarrelling into a noun naming the event or activity. DBP also records the proverb sehabis kelahi teringat silat: remembering one's fighting skills only after the quarrel. Its lesson concerns solutions remembered too late, rather than praise for fighting. [DBP: kelahi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=kelahi)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: kelahi 是争斗；per-…-an 把动作装成“一件事”：perkelahian 就是一场争吵或打斗。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 描述他人时带有明确的冲突判断。若只是意见不一致，宜用 perbezaan pendapat，避免把正常讨论说成争斗。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于新闻、校纪通报和事件叙述。劝架时可说 Bertenang dahulu（先冷静一下）；公开谈论家庭争吵时应顾及当事人的隐私。
